hero.title: The most
hero.description: Far from the noise and hustle of classic social networks. CatCat is a space designed for genuine discussion, authentic sharing, and creativity. Take your time, connect with those who inspire you, and finally feel at home.

download.description: Enjoy an ultra-smooth experience. CatCat is designed to be lightweight, fast, and never slow you down.

feature1.description: CatCat servers are organized into thematic channels where you can collaborate, share your passions, or simply talk about your day without cluttering a general chat.

feature2.description: Take a seat in a channel and see who is online. Real-time typing indicators and message reactions make every conversation lively and fun.

feature3.description: Create roles, manage permissions, and empower your members. From invitations to bans, you have total control over your space.

footer.copyright: CatCat. Designed with passion and lots of kibbles by the Epitech team.
